records.title: TOWERS, SIDE AND BACK WALLS
records.specText:
Towers:
  Self-supporting, sound-reflecting towers with counterweighted, nesting bases.
  3 radiused panels hinged together to obtain tower width as indicated on the Drawings.
  Maximum Total Width per Tower: [12] feet.
  Maximum Total Height of Tower: [30] feet.
Base Assembly:
  Counterweight:
    Significant weight to safely move towers about stage.
    Permanently fastened to tower frame.
  Towers nest within each other to use a minimum of storage space.
Structural Frame: Incorporate tower wing hinges.
Tower Transporter:
  Supply [1] tower transporter.
  Locks onto and lifts towers, allowing them to move safely about stage.
  Transporter Frame:
    2-inch OD steel tube.
    Casters: Three 5-point, zero-throw, orbital casters, each with a load rating of 1,750 lbs.
  Allow towers to be moved in any direction to speed setup.
  Tower Lifting:
    Hydraulic pump and rams.
    Devices requiring electrical power cord to transport towers: Not acceptable.
  Finish: Black, baked-on powder coat.
Each Base: 3 adjustable height levelers to allow for minor irregularities in stage floor.
At Installation of Towers:
  Insert numbered markers flush with stage floor indicating location of each tower to ensure consistent setup.
  Markers: Coded to match each of the arrangements indicated on the Drawings.
Each Side-Wall Tower: 2 doorways for entering and exiting performing area.
Safety Instructions: Affix to tower in plain view instructions pertaining to safe handling and operation of towers.
Tower Hardware:
  Hardware necessary to safely transport towers to and from storage and lock into place when in use position.
  Frame: Modular, 2-inch OD steel tube.
  Counterweight: Steel plates stacked in enclosed tamper-proof weight box.
  Levelers: Acme thread with 3-inch-diameter rubber pad.
  Finish: Black powder coat.
records.notes: Oshkosh North sizes/quantity put in [brackets] — edit per job.

records.title: OVERHEAD SOUND REFLECTORS
records.specText:
Sound reflective panels supported from existing stage rigging, including integral hardware for single-pipe storage without interference with adjacent stage equipment.
Suspended from truss batten.
Panel Width Dimensions: Match approximate spacing of rigging cable attachment to pipe batten.
Storage:
  Allow entire row to be rotated to storage position at 1 time by 2 people.
  No tools necessary to rotate panels for storage.
  Maximum Storage Space: Typically 5 inches to 7 inches on each side of pipe batten centerline, depending on ceiling and light fixture configuration.
Each Row of Overhead Panels: Equip with necessary hardware to hang from recommended 1-1/2-inch schedule 40 pipe batten.
Hardware:
  Permit angular adjustment from horizontal plane to 40 degrees.
  Capability of locking panels in a vertical position, so they may be stored on battens in stage loft.
Safety Instructions: Provide instructions pertaining to safe handling of overhead panels.
Ceiling Schedule:
  [Row 1-3: 7’9” wide, tapered ends — per Drawings]
    [7] hanger points with lighting fixtures per plan.
records.notes: Oshkosh North ceiling schedule put in [brackets] — edit per job.

records.title: PANELS
records.specText:
Sound-reflecting laminated panels.
Panel Thickness: 1-5/8 inches.
Exposed Face:
  0.060-inch-thick, Formica high-pressure laminate.
  Fire Rated: Class C.
Substrate: 1/8-inch tempered hardboard each side of core.
Backing:
  Natural finish, high-pressure laminate.
  Fire Rated: Class C.
Core:
  3/8-inch cell, 80-80-15 phenolic-impregnated, cellulose honeycomb.
  Thickness: 1.3 inches.
Frame:
  Exposed Edges of Individual Panels: Protect by extruded aluminum frame/edging with injected molded corners.
  Continuous Edge Slot: Allow mechanical fastener attachment to tower structural frame.
Adhesive:
  High-solid, pressure-cured, moisture-activated, urethane structural adhesive.
  Contact-Type Adhesives: Not acceptable.
Exterior Surface Shape: Bowed to [6'-0"] radius.
Weight:
  Minimum of 2-1/2 lbs per square foot, excluding frame weight.
  Panels of Less Weight: Deemed insufficient to reflect low-frequency sound; not acceptable.
Finish:
  Panel Face Surface: No exposed fasteners.
  Face Finish: Matte.
  Panel Edges: Flat black, anodized.
  Panel Face Color: Color will be selected from standard colors by Owner's representative.
records.notes: Panel radius put in [brackets] in case it varies by job.

records.title: STAGE EXTENSION PLATFORM SYSTEMS
records.specText:
Stage Extension Platform System Components:
  Support Systems: Clear Span
  Decks
  Skirting
  Transport Carts
  Pit Net
Portable System
Incorporate "floating deck" design, permitting use of modular decks in conjunction with various support systems to create performance staging with heights ranging from 3.2 inches to 108 inches.
Floating Deck: When coupled with StageRight major event support systems, permits creation of performance stage.
System Assembly: No special equipment or tools required.
Maximum Weight of Individual Components: Approximately 140 pounds.
Support Structure: Permit bridging of decks between units, facilitating rapid setup and leveling.

records.title: SUPPORT SYSTEMS – CLEAR SPAN
records.specText:
Support Systems: “I-Beam”
Description: Shall be structured elements that allow decks to be supported from ledger angles. Beams shall have locator nodes for capturing deck corners.
Locator Nodes:
  Conical Nodes on Locator Plates: Guide decks into location and proper alignment, securing them in place without tools, clamps, or clips
  Decks: Fasten in place and stage sections interlock without tools, clamps, or separate processes.
Adjustable Height:
  Height: Adjust in increments of 2 inches without tools.
  Adjustments : Executed from standing position by raising or lowering inner column of supports.

records.title: DECKS
records.specText:
Material: Composite structure with skins of 1/8-inch, exterior-grade, Douglas fir plywood, laminated to 0.35-inch surfaces and bonded to 2-1/4-inch-thick honeycomb-core material with waterproof urethane adhesive.
Performance Surfaces:
  “TechStage”, 0.095-inch surface of fiberglass-reinforced polymeric with black texture.
  “PolyTrac”, black, slip-resistant ABS.
Edging:
  Material: Aluminum alloy 6005-T5.
  Enclose deck.
  Extruded Interlock Track: Receive accessories.
  Attach to Deck: Adhesives and riveted corner brackets.
  Finish: Silver anodize or black powder coat paint.
Relationship with Support Systems: Not permanently part of a given support system, but function with several support structures available from manufacturer.
Loads:
  Design decks to support a load of 125 pounds per square foot and a point load of 600 pounds on a 1inch-square area on honeycomb core with 3/8-inch cell. \
  Carpeted Surface: Support a point load of 300 pounds on a 1-inch-square area on honeycomb core with 3/8-inch cell.
Construction: No bolts or welded joining of deck components.
Honeycomb Core Design: Absorbs drum-head effect and distracting foot noise.
Decks Not Acceptable: Single-sided frame-style decks with sound-absorbing material added to bottom.

records.title: ACCESSORIES
records.specText:
Skirting:
  Material: Noncombustible, 100 percent PolyTwill.
  Conformance: Local fire codes.
  Skirt Attachment Clips:
    Material: Semi-rigid vinyl.
    Sewn into top hem of skirt at regular intervals along its entire length.
    Engage into deck interlock track for attachment to stage.
  Skirt Height Adjustment: Velcro strips sewn into reverse side of skirt.
  Skirting Valence: Knife or box pleated with a fullness of 50 percent.
Transport Carts:
  Transport stage extension platform systems.
  Material: Welded steel tubing.
  Fork Truck Access: 4 sides.
  Casters: Minimum of 4 heavy-duty swivel casters.
  Contain their intended load in a secure and organized manner.
Pit Net.
  Provide and install an orchestral pit safety net along with the pit filler. Pit Net should include a conductors hatch on center that can be removable.
Cable Pass Hatch

records.specText:
Material
  22oz Encore Synthetic Velour
Color:
  Cypress
Fabrication
  Top hem shall be turned and reinforced with continuous 3” polypro webbing. Curtains shall be sewn with 50% Fullness.
  A #3 brass grommet shall be inserted every 12” and at ends and contain a 30” dark heavy grade 3/4” twill tape for tying curtain to pipe.
  Bottom hem shall be 5 inches. Side hems shall be a minimum of 3”.

records.title: RIGGING PACKAGED HOISTS
records.basisOfDesign: Prodigy P1 as manufactured by ETC.
records.specText:
Basis of Design: Prodigy P1 as manufactured by ETC.
  Minimum Safety Factor: 10:1 for equipment and hardware unless specified otherwise.
  Standards Compliance: UL Listed and tested as a complete system made up of UL listed components.
  Hoists:
    Wire Rope Lift Lines: Design factor of 10:1. Ultimate strength: 4200 lb.
    Load Path Components Between Building Structure and Batten: Must exceed breaking strength of wire rope.
    Motor Brake: Rated at 125 percent of motor torque.
    Capable of Supporting the Following Loads:
      General Purpose Hoists:
        P1900G 30 fpm (0.15 m per s): Capacity: 2000 lb (907 kg) in standard configuration. Powerhead (HxWxL): 16 x 18 x 53.5 inches (406 x 157 x 1359 mm). Weight: 580 lb (263 kg).
      Stage Electric Hoists:
        P1500E 30 fpm (0.15 m per s): Capacity: 1500 lb (680 kg) in standard configuration. Powerhead (HxWxL): 16 x 18 x 53.5 inches (406 x 157 x 1359 mm). Weight: 580 lb (263 kg).
    Hoists: Major components.
      Powerhead.
      Compression tube with beam clamps, loft blocks, lift line and lift line terminations, Right Angle Cable Adjuster (RACA).
      Pipe batten.
      Electric Hoists: Major components.
        Cable management system.
        Power and control distribution strip.
    Features:
      Compression Tube: Prevents hoist system lateral forces from transferring to building. Hoisting systems imposing lateral loads on buildings are not acceptable.
      Built-in load cell.
      Built-in slack line sensor.
      Emergency contactor built into the hoist.
      Absolute position encoders.
  Compression Tube and Beam Clamps:
    Compression Tube: Extruded aluminum channel, engineered in conjunction with beam clamps to neutralize rigging-generated lateral forces on buildings.
      Support the system loft blocks.
      Sections joined in a continuous assembly by a pair of dedicated splicing plates at each tube joint.
      Installed with dedicated beam clamps that allow tube to snap into place and fractionally move horizontally under load.
    Beam Clamps: Capable of attaching to horizontal beams, joists, truss flanges or flat steel plates. Thickness: 1/4 to 1 inch (6 to 25 mm). Width: 4 to 14 inches (102 to 356 mm).
  Loft Blocks: Assemblies of steel side plates, a wire rope idler, sheave, bearings, shaft locked against rotation and support hardware.
    Loft blocks are inserted into the slot on the bottom of compression tube positioned no closer than 48 inches (1219 mm) from each other, unless muled.
    Loft Block Sheaves: 5 inches (127 mm) diameter. Contain a pair of press fit sealed ball bearings and are concentric about the hub and evenly balanced for rotation.
      Lift Lines: Travel in groove sized for 3/16 inch (5 mm) diameter wire rope per latest edition of Wire Rope Users' Manual, published by the Wire Rope Technical Board.
    Idler: on top of loft block to guide and support lift lines as they pass the block.
    Hoisting systems requiring loft blocks be mounted directly to facility structure are not acceptable.

records.title: CABLE MANAGEMENT
records.basisOfDesign: Prodigy Cable Management.
records.specText:
Cable Management System for Electrics: Prodigy Cable Management.
  Load Circuits and Control Wiring: Fed to distribution trough; a built-in cable management system allowing flat feeder cable to fold and store along top of connector strip.
  At High Trim: Vertical storage height from bottom of the mounting steel to the horizontal centerline of batten shall be no greater than:
    52 in (1.321 m) when used with Prodigy P1 hoists.
  Flat Cable: Meet physical and thermal requirements of UL for 20 A loads. Four flat cables may be fed from each end of distribution system providing power for 24 circuits from each end of system A maximum of 48 total circuits.
    One ground wire, one data cable, individually insulated hot and neutral conductor for each of six. 120 V 20 A circuits.
    Passes through a strain relief before entering termination box at designated end of raceway. Within raceway, wiring is attached at the factory to a terminal block.
  Connector Strip: Built to length specified with outlets located as specified and as shown on Drawings.
    Outlets: 15 amp grounded pin connectors
    Distro Trough: May contain connectors for Ethernet and DMX connections.
  Hoisting systems utilizing cable management systems from third-party vendors are to be fully integrated into hoisting system without additional structural changes or changes to rigging controller.

records.title: MAINS FED INTELLIGENT RELAY ENCLOSURE
records.basisOfDesign: Sensor IQ 120V
records.specText:
Basis of Design: Sensor IQ 120V
Standards Compliance:
  The relay shall be UL508, UL67, and UL924 Listed.
Mechanical:
  Refer to Drawings for counts and type.
  The panel shall be constructed of 16-gauge galvannealed steel. All panel components shall be properly treated or finished in fine-textured, scratch resistant paint The relay shall be convection-cooled and operate without cooling fans.
  Breaker panels shall be capable of being mounted on the surface of a wall or recessed mounted.
  Choice of panel covers shall be available for surface or recess mount applications. This outer panel shall ship complete with a locking door to limit access to electronics and breakers.
Control:
  Net3 protocol suite including ANSI E1.31 Streaming ACN (sACN)
  The power controller shall directly support 2 ports of control input using ANSI E1.11 USITT DMX512-A.
  The user interface shall contain an LCD display with button pad to include 0-9 number entry, up, down back arrow navigation and enter
  Test shortcut button shall be available for local activation of preset, sequence and set level overrides
Electrical:
  Input Method: 120/208V three phase 4-wire plus ground
  The enclosure shall support a maximum feed size.
    100 Amps at 12 circuits
    200 Amps at 24 circuits
    400 Amps at 48 circuits
records.notes: One spec covers all four Sensor IQ models; they differ by circuit count (12/24/48). Counts per Drawings.

records.title: MAINS FED POWER CONTROL ENCLOSURE
records.basisOfDesign: Unison DRd Series Power Control Enclosure
records.specText:
Basis of Design: Unison DRd Series Power Control Enclosure
Standards Compliance:
  The relay shall be ETL Listed, and CE Compliant.
Mechanical:
  The power control enclosure shall be a surface mounted, deadfront switchboard, constructed of 18-guage formed steel panels with a hinged, lockable full-height door containing an integral electrostatic air filter. Enclosures shall be sized to accept one control processor, one station power module, and accessories.
Control:
  The fully digital enclosure shall be available with six or twelve dimmer module spaces, one processor and a single station power supply.
    Refer to Drawings for module counts and type.
  Enclosures shall be designed to support the wire terminations for AC (single phase), Echelon link power, 24Vdc, configurable DMX512A (In or Out), DMX512A Output, RS232 Serial In/Out ,Unshielded Twisted Pair (UTP) Category 5/5e, 4x Contact Closure In, and 4x Contact Closure Out.
Electrical:
  A single low-noise fan shall be located at the top of each enclosure. The fan shall draw all intake air through the integral electrostatic air filter, over the surfaces of the module housing and out the top of the enclosure.
  The dimmer shall shut itself down electronically to prevent overload.
  Enclosures shall be available in three-phase, main lug configurations which support 100, 120, 230, 240, or 277 Volt mains feed input.
Enclosures shall be completely pre-wired by the manufacturer. The contractor shall provide input feed, load, and control wiring.

records.title: POWERSAFE COMPANY SWITCHES
records.basisOfDesign: PowerSafe Company Switch by ETC Inc. A fault-current-limiting option provides additional safety in event of a short circuit, allowing safe connection of equipment with lower Short Circuit Current Rating (SCCR) and reducing arc-flash hazard.
records.specText:
Product: PowerSafe Company Switch by ETC Inc. A fault-current-limiting option provides additional safety in event of a short circuit, allowing safe connection of equipment with lower Short Circuit Current Rating (SCCR) and reducing arc-flash hazard.
  Model: PSC. PowerSafe Compact: Does not include connector chamber, dual neutral, tie-off, LED work lights or support for 400 A capacity.
    Swing-Hinged Brackets: Lock covers in place until front door is opened, preventing connector insertion under power.
    Breaker: 100 percent rated 100 A or 200 A.
  Mechanical:
    Wall-mount unit with integral keyhole fixing points.
    16 ga welded steel cabinet, rated NEMA 1.
    Locking swing hinged door with clamp latch.
    Fine-textured, scratch-resistant epoxy paint.
    Secondary door for access to bare-end tie-ins.
    Conduit entry via top or side.
    Solid, top, and side panel free of conduit knockouts allow for greater flexibility in contractor conduit entry.
    Integral breaker lockout bracket supports standard lockout/tagout procedures to prevent any persons from turning the breaker "on" while the lock is in place.
  Electrical:
    Power Input: 120/208 V Three-phase, four-wire plus ground.
    Copper and aluminum feeders are allowed.
    100 percent rated 100 A, 200 A, or 400 A breaker.
    65,000A SCCR symmetrical rated system.
    Output lugs:
      Accommodate up to 4/0 class K cables using 500 kcmil screw terminals.
    Single-phase cam-style connector outputs:
      Reverse neutral and ground cam-style connector configuration.
    Phase Leg Connectors: Female. Ground and Neutral: Male.
    Current Transformers: Can optionally be installed in the field for connection to external third-party power meters.
    Shunt trip safety interlock: Disconnects output power when cabinet door is opened.
    Short Circuit Current Rating: 65,000 Amp.
    Rated Main Breaker: 100 percent.
    Iso Ground: Allows isolation between enclosure ground and equipment ground for use with audio systems.
    Power Indicators: LEDs light up to show that power is on/available between each phase and neutral.
    Lockout/Tagout: Accepts third-party locks on built-in bracket for support of NFPA 70E safety lockout/tagout procedures.
  Standards Compliance: cULus. Listed to UL 891 and CSA C22.2 No. 14. Models and quantities of PowerSafe company switches to be supplied as shown on project drawings.
records.notes: Covers both PowerSafe models. Note: the current text describes the PSC (Compact) in detail.

records.title: ARCHITECTURAL CONTROL PROCESSOR – ENCLOSURE MOUNT
records.specText:
General
  The Architectural Control Processor shall be the Unison Paradigm Series P-ACP-E Mk2 Control Processor (enclosure mount) as manufactured by Electronic Theatre Controls, Inc., or equal.
  The ACP shall be convection cooled.
  The RJ-45 receptacle shall be secured behind the locking door.
Capacity
  Shall support 1024 channels of control
  Shall support 2 physical DMX ports, each of which may be configured as an input or output
System
  Runtime application shall utilize support Net3 system interoperability
  System shall support the use of Network Time Protocol for real time clock synchronization
  System shall support remote firmware upload an over Ethernet connection from a connected PC running the Light Designer software or another connected processor.
  System shall support local firmware upload from removable media (SD Card, USB Flash Drive)
Diagnostics
  Shall output an Event log
  Standard log shall store a fixed-length history of recent activity
  Separate critical log shall only store important messages (such as boot-up settings)
Mechanical
  The Architectural Control Processor (ACP) assembly shall be designed for use in Unison DRd Series Power Enclosures with a Mk2 CPU2 Dimming Engine and ERn Mk2 Series Control Enclosures.
  The processor shall utilize microprocessor based, solid state technology to provide multi-scene lighting and building control.
  ACP module electronics shall be contained in a plug-in assembly.
  The module shall be housed in a formed steel body and contain no discrete wire connections.
  No tools shall be required for module removal or insertion.
records.notes: Model updated to P-ACP-E Mk2 and compatible enclosures added, per ETC Paradigm ordering guide (sent by Jeff 2026-09-28). DIN-mount version is PS-260961-006.

  The ACP shall be convection cooled.
  The RJ-45 receptacle shall be secured behind the locking door.
Capacity
  Shall support 1024 channels of control
  Shall support 2 physical DMX ports, each of which may be configured as an input or output
System

  System shall support the use of Network Time Protocol for real time clock synchronization
  System shall support remote firmware upload an over Ethernet connection from a connected PC running the Light Designer software or another connected processor.
  System shall support local firmware upload from removable media (SD Card, USB Flash Drive)
Diagnostics
  Shall output an Event log
  Standard log shall store a fixed-length history of recent activity
  Separate critical log shall only store important messages (such as boot-up settings)
Mechanical
  The Architectural Control Processor (ACP) shall be able to be mounted in a typical equipment rack with a separate enclosure
  Compatible Enclosures: DIN8 Mini, DIN14 Small, or DIN28 Large DIN Enclosure, or DIN-RM DIN rail rack-mount kit.

records.title: EMERGENCY DMX CONTROLLER
records.specText:
General
  The Emergency DMX Controller shall be the DEBC-6 as manufactured by ETC, Inc., or equal.
  Functional
    Capable of overriding a single universe of DMX512 control signals from "Normal" to "Bypass" when a trigger signal is detected via a contact closure trigger input.
      Recalled immediately on restart if trigger is also applied at restart.
    Capable of recording a single DMX preset (snapshot) of 512 channels for recall during "Bypass" mode.
    Internally accessible, labeled DIP switches for configuration of:
      DMX Record Mode: 512 channels. Selected channels, snapshot.
      Contact Input Type: Normally open (default). Normally closed.
      Wait Time for Restore incoming DMX; Bypass Trigger Removed: 0 Seconds (default). 10 second wait. 30 second wait. 10 minute wait.
    Single Bypass Input Using Two Input Modes:
      Bypass Triggering: Via a maintained contact input configurable for normally open (N.O.) or normally closed (N.C.) operation.
      Contact Input: 12 VDC wet input for interface with fire alarm or secondary trigging systems.
  Mechanical
    Surface Mounted Enclosure. Removable Front Cover: 16-gauge, formed steel.
    Test Button: Front enclosure accessible without removing panels.
    Single, internally accessible button for DMX Record (snapshot) with an indicator LED for record action.
  Electrical
    Input Power: 100 to 277 V, 50/60 Hz, 150 mA maximum current.
    Labeled, socketed termination connections for DMX Input and Output wiring.
    Labeled, socketed termination for bypass contact input.

records.title: EMERGENCY BYPASS DETECTOR
records.specText:
General
  The Emergency Bypass Detector shall be the EBDK as manufactured by ETC, Inc., or equal.
  Standards Compliance:
    UL and cUL Section 924 Listed.
  Mechanical
    Surface Mounted Enclosure. Removable Front Cover: 16-gauge, formed steel.
    Breaker: 3 pole, 10 amp for local over-current protection and simulation of normal power loss.
    Lockable Door: Limits access to over-current protection breaker.
    Components to be properly treated and finished.
    Discrete high and low voltage wiring compartments with voltage barrier.
  Electrical:
    Input Power: 100 to 277 V. Field configurable for single-phase, bi-phase, and three-phase operation without additional components.
    Phase Loss Detection Circuitry: 0.5 second delay to prevent nuisance tripping.
    Isolated Outputs: For connection to multiple dimming products simultaneously.
    Control Wire Connections: Terminated via factory provided connectors.
      Support 12 to 22-gauge wiring.
      Emergency Lighting Input: Support load shedding.
    Bypass Detection Kit: Proves a normally-closed input for interface with fire alarm systems. UL and cUL Section 924 Listed for interaction with similarly listed dimming and switching panels.

records.specText:
Basis of Design: EOS Family Software V3 or Better
General Requirements
  The following items may be contained in non-volatile electronic memory and stored to an onboard solid-state hard drive or to any USB storage device.
    Cues: 100,000.
    Groups: 10,000.
    Palettes: 4 x 10,000 (Intensity, Focus, Color and Beam).,
    Macros: 99,999.
    Effects: 10,000.
  Recorded cue lists: May be played back simultaneously on up to 200 faders.
    HTP/LTP intensity flags, assert, proportional, intensity master or manual master fade control and priority status may be placed on each cue list.

  Channels: Are to, by default, respond to cue information by last instruction, with discrete rate control provided for all cues.
  Fully integrated 3D visualization and programming environment included.
    The 3D environment displays a replica of live output to the lighting system, and displays recorded states in Blind.
  Software Upgrades: By user via USB flash drive. Install software updates in all desks, processor units and video remotes from one device over the network.
